Our edge

Google builds the engine. Behavioral science steers it.

Google's AI optimizes to whatever signal it's given. Behavioral economics explains why people actually buy. Our frameworks turn that into the signals, creative and measures Google's AI runs on, across all four pillars.

Emotion firstPeople decide with feeling, then justify with logic.
Value over priceWhat a buyer believes they get outweighs what it costs.
Context shapes choiceThe same offer lands differently at each stage.
How the frameworks steer each pillar
Google CloudWhy does the customer buy and stay?Empathy Mapping · Customer Journey to Insight MappingBuyer motives modeled as data in BigQuery and run as code on Agent Platform, so every recommendation cites its source.
CreativeWhat will make them stop, feel and act?StoryVesting · Behavioral Insights MatrixSynthetic audiences built on these frameworks explain what CPI finds and turn it into a brief for every audience and stage.
Marketing PlatformWhat does value really look like?North Star Metric · Behavioral EconomicsOne definition of customer value that every platform, bid strategy and measurement model reads.
Google MediaWhich customers are worth the most?Bowtie FunnelLifetime value and buyer-stage signals, so bidding chases the customers worth the most over time.
